LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_Intro: Schedule Date or Lovin on the Schedule tab. Date is a walk / table / hangout (mood + opinion, no bed). Lovin still uses a shared double. Adults without a partner in that bed can have private time. Adults without a lover can grow a relationship: friends, sweethearts, then boyfriend/girlfriend, then lovers. Lovin stays locked until they are a real pair. Ideology that forbids lovin, and Biotech sterile genes, reroute to a date instead of forcing the job. With Romance on the Rim, Date Night waits if RotR is already running a romance job, and a finished date fills that romance need. With RimJobWorld, Lovin hours start RJW's bed job (private time uses RJW masturbation) instead of fighting vanilla Lovin. Missing extras are a no-op.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_PregnancySafeTip: ON (recommended): only shortens lovin chance while scheduled; keeps vanilla post-lovin cooldown. Date uses the same wait (~4–8 hours) after a finished date. OFF with Eager: mirrors Always Do Lovin cooldown (~100 ticks) for lovin and dating.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_EagerTip: Shortens post-lovin and post-date cooldown like the Always Do Lovin debug option (~100 ticks). Can spam pregnancy rolls — leave off unless you want that.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_SelfLovinTip: Adults on Lovin hours use their own bed when a partner is not sharing a double. No pregnancy. Same cooldown as lovin. Children never qualify.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_WindowBedTip: Temporarily assign the rendezvous double to the couple for the Lovin window, then restore their previous beds. Off if you want to assign beds yourself.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_ActivitiesTip: Dates pick a real activity based on what's available: dinner at a table, a picnic, a walk, stargazing at night, dancing at a gather spot, a small gift, or recreation near a joy building. Off: dates are always a simple hangout.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_QualityTip: Date outcomes vary with the activity, venue beauty, weather, and a little luck — wonderful, nice, or awkward. Off: every finished date gives the flat nice-date thought.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_GiftsTip: One partner may fetch a small luxury (beer, chocolate, ambrosia...) and hand it over for a mood and opinion boost. The item moves to the partner's inventory.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_GiftExtend: Also accept joy luxuries as gifts
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_GiftExtendTip: Scans for small joy-giving ingestibles so modded chocolates and drinks can be gifts too.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_GiftList: Extra gift items (empty = Beer, Chocolate, Ambrosia, Psychite tea, Insect jelly):
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_PostDateBoostTip: A finished date improves the couple's lovin chance for about one in-game day.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_AnniversariesTip: On the anniversary of a love bond: a letter, a special mood if they go on a date that day, and a sting if the day passes without one. Every fifth year is a milestone with a bigger mood. Off: no calendar letters or anniversary moods.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_FavoriteSpotTip: Couples remember where their best dates happened and prefer to go back. A ruined date can sour that venue, and a breakup wipes the couple's spot. Off: every date picks a fresh spot.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_DoubleDatesTip: Two couples with overlapping Date hours may share a table, picnic, or gather spot. Quality rolls once for the group; the evening spills into opinions of the other pair. If the other couple never shows, they date alone. Couples remember how past double dates went: pairs who hit it off pick each other again, pairs who keep clashing stop pairing up.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_GradualRomanceTip: Adults without a lover can date as friends, then sweethearts, then boyfriend/girlfriend. Good dates and opinion climb each step; the last step makes them vanilla lovers. Lovin stays locked until then. Existing couples skip the ladder. Off: only lovers and spouses can date.
LanguageData.DateNight_Letter_BecameLoversText: {PAWN} and {PARTNER} are lovers now. Those dates added up.
LanguageData.DateNight_Letter_AnniversaryText: {PAWN} and {PARTNER} have been together for {YEARS}. A date today would mean the world — letting it pass without one will sting.
LanguageData.DateNight_Letter_AnniversaryMilestoneTex: {PAWN} and {PARTNER} have been together for {YEARS} — a milestone. A date today would mean the world — letting it pass without one will sting.
LanguageData.DateNight_Alert_MismatchDesc: A lover, sweetheart, or date partner has Date or Lovin painted, but the other does not — or they painted different hours. Paint the same hours on both.
LanguageData.DateNight_Alert_MismatchSyncHint: Click this alert to sync a partner's painted hours.
LanguageData.DateNight_ScheduleComboTip: Date (click). Lovin is in the ▾ menu. This button stays last on the extra schedule row.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_RomanceGizmosTip: Show the Romance panel and "Ask out tonight" buttons when a colonist is selected.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_ColumnOffsetTip: Date Night places its Schedule tab button after the vanilla, Rimbody and Schedule Everything buttons. If another mod adds a button and they overlap, move the Date button by whole cells here. 0 = automatic.
LanguageData.DateNight_Gizmo_RomanceDesc: Show this colonist's romance: stage, anniversary, last date, favourite spot and double-date rapport.
LanguageData.DateNight_Gizmo_AskOutDesc: Plan one date with {0} at the next free evening hour, without changing either schedule.
LanguageData.DateNight_Gizmo_AskOutUnavailable: {0} can't go on a date right now.
LanguageData.DateNight_AskOut_Planned: {0} asked {1} out. Their date starts at {2}:00.
LanguageData.DateNight_Romance_Progress: Good dates toward the next step: {0} / {1}
LanguageData.DateNight_Gizmo_BabyDesc: This colonist and {0} are trying for a baby. Lovin comes about twice as often and uses the short cooldown during Lovin hours. This turns off by itself once she is pregnant.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_VisualsTip: Date Night's own effects: a rose heart for gifts, sparkles after a wonderful date, stars while stargazing, confetti on milestone anniversaries, a candle glow at dinner, a shimmer when stargazing, a glow on the dance floor, and a ring on the selected couple's favourite spot and Lovin bed. Off: only the vanilla heart.
